camel_example: aliyun ndr DescribeProtoLogs --region cn-hangzhou --Site global --ToTime 1788395400000 --PageSize 10 --Page 1 --Lang zh --FromTime 1788393600000 --LogFilter '{"logicOp":"and","logFilterItems":[{"logField":"src_ip","op":"=","value":"192.0.2.10"}]}' --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries protocol logs by time range, site, and filter conditions with paged query. The log fields in the response vary depending on the protocol type. This operation does not return the total number of logs. To obtain the total count, invoke DescribeProtoLogTotalCount with the same FromTime, ToTime, Site, and LogFilter parameters
description_zh: 按时间范围、站点和过滤条件分页查询协议日志。响应中的日志字段随协议类型而变化。本接口不返回日志总数；需要总数时，使用相同的 FromTime、ToTime、Site 和 LogFilter 调用 DescribeProtoLogTotalCount
name: DescribeProtoLogs

parameters.help_en: The log filter conditions in a JSON string. logicOp specifies and or or. logFilterItems is an array of conditions, each containing logField, op, and value, where value is a string. logFilters can contain nested condition groups with the same structure. If this parameter is not specified, no field-level filtering is applied. You can call ListProtoLogSupportIndex to retrieve the available fields and operators
parameters.help_zh: 日志过滤条件，使用 JSON 字符串。logicOp 为 and 或 or；logFilterItems 为条件数组，每项包含 logField、op、value，value 使用字符串；logFilters 可嵌套同结构的条件组。不传时不附加字段过滤。可用字段和运算符通过 ListProtoLogSupportIndex 获取
parameters.name: log_filter

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. If this parameter is not specified or is set to 0, the time 30 minutes before the current time is used. The value must not be later than ToTime. Specify both the start time and end time
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。不传或传 0 时，使用当前时间前 30 分钟；须不晚于 ToTime。建议同时传入开始和结束时间
parameters.name: from_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. If this parameter is not specified or is set to 0, the current time is used. The value must not be earlier than FromTime. If FromTime equals ToTime, the system queries logs within the 1-second window ending at ToTime
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。不传或传 0 时，使用当前时间；须不早于 FromTime。当 FromTime 与 ToTime 相等时，系统按 ToTime 前 1 秒至 ToTime 的时间范围查询
parameters.name: to_time

parameters.help_en: The page number, starting from 1. If this parameter is not specified or is set to 0, page 1 is used
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码，从 1 开始。不传或传 0 时使用第 1 页
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回条数，取值为 1～100，默认值为 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The language of the log display values. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.
en: English.

Default value: zh
parameters.help_zh: 日志展示值的语言。zh 表示中文，en 表示英文；不传时使用中文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The site for the log query. You can obtain available sites from the Sites field returned by DescribeDeliveryDestination. In multi-site scenarios, the specified site is used if it is valid. If no site is specified or the specified site is unavailable, the system automatically selects an available site. If only one site is available, that site is used. If no site is available, the LogDeliveryNotOpen error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 日志查询站点，可从 DescribeDeliveryDestination 返回的 Sites 中获取。多站点场景下优先使用有效的指定站点；未指定或指定站点不可用时，系统自动选择可用站点。仅有一个可用站点时使用该站点；无可用站点时返回 LogDeliveryNotOpen
parameters.name: site

Data.description_en: The paging result of protocol logs
Data.description_zh: 协议日志分页查询结果

List.description_en: The list of protocol logs on the current page, returned in reverse chronological order. Each log entry is a dynamic field object whose fields vary depending on the log type and storage configuration. The list is empty if no matching logs are found
List.description_zh: 当前页协议日志列表，按日志时间倒序返回。每条日志为动态字段对象，字段随日志类型和存储配置而变化；没有匹配日志时列表为空

additionalProperties.description_en: The value of a dynamic field in the log. The type varies depending on the field. This example shows the string value of the source IP field
additionalProperties.description_zh: 日志动态字段的值，其类型随字段而变化。此示例展示源 IP 字段的字符串值

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page that takes effect
PageSize.description_zh: 当前生效的每页返回条数

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. This field is empty when the request succeeds. The example shows a scenario where the query range is invalid
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；请求成功时为空。示例展示查询范围无效场景

Message.description_en: The result message of the request. This field describes the error cause when the request fails. The example shows a scenario where the query range is invalid
Message.description_zh: 请求结果信息；失败时用于说明错误原因。示例展示查询范围无效场景

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate this request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次请求

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
